note: Evaluation-only semantics for candidate experts. This file does NOT register them in the Agent toolbox and is not read by the state machine; it is used by scripts/g8_external_eval.py so the offline report has a direction and an official threshold. No threshold is fitted or tuned here.

raw_score.meaning: 官方 sigmoid 输出；越高越像 AI 生成

threshold.chosen_on: 官方代码 validate() 的默认决策边界（accuracy/AP/AUC 默认 threshold=0.5）

preprocess.name: 官方 SPAI 测试变换
preprocess.detail: 原分辨率（不缩放/不裁剪）→ PadIfNeeded 到 ≥224×224 → [0,1] 归一化 → ToTensor

raw_score.meaning: 官方 softmax 的 fake 类概率（[:,1]）；越高越像 AI 生成

threshold.chosen_on: 官方 engine_finetune.py 的 accuracy(..., y_pred > 0.5) 默认边界

preprocess.name: 官方 AIDE 测试预处理
preprocess.detail: PIL RGB → ToTensor → DCT 极值 patch（4 个变体）→ Resize 256×256 → ImageNet 归一化；原图同样 Resize 256 并归一化；输入 5×3×256×256
